summary.text:
Need recover secret to /app/secret.txt. Clean repository so secret cannot be found anywhere. Need make sure irrelevant files and commit messages untouched. We need remove dangling commit/blob and perhaps old tree and reflog references. Git gc prune now may remove unreachable objects. But reflog contains dangling commit, so expire reflog and gc prune. Also perhaps commit content referenced by log messages? Need ensure secret gone anywhere. We should preserve current history and messages. Need maybe repack and prune.

Let's write secret. Then git reflog expire --expire=now --all, git gc --prune=now --aggressive maybe. Then verify git cat-file --batch-all-objects no secret, grep .git, fsck. Need consider reflog original commit? Commit tree has secret and secret filename. Even if objects pruned, pack files? git gc should repack and prune all unreachable. Need perhaps remove remote refs? There are none. Also stash? Let's inspect git config, refs, replace objects, notes? We'll clean robustly.

First write /app/secret.txt and capture exact. Then cleanup.

content.text: Recovered secret: `secret[lost_and_found_in_git]`. Now I'll write it to `/app/secret.txt`, expunge all reflog entries and unreachable objects, and verify the secret is gone from the repository while preserving the current commits/files.

output.name: bash
output.arguments: {"command": "printf '%s\\n' 'secret[lost_and_found_in_git]' > /app/secret.txt && cat /app/secret.txt && cd /app/repo && git reflog expire --expire=now --expire-unreachable=now --all && git gc --prune=now --aggressive && echo '=== status/log ===' && git status --short --branch && git log --all --oneline --decorate --stat && echo '=== refs/reflog ===' && git show-ref && git reflog --all || true"}
